description: Realtime progress visibility for `heare watch` dashboard. Between speech -> decision -> action the dashboard is currently a black hole. Ship one PR that (a) adds an append-only `events` table in SQLite at schema v3 with WAL mode, (b) wires fail-safe fire-and-forget emitters at every decider FSM state transition via a 256-slot asyncio.Queue + long-lived drainer, (c) refactors ClaudeCLI._run from proc.communicate() to an async readline loop that tees stdout to a per-line callback (with \r-splitting for progress-bar tools and 8KB LimitOverrunError fallback), wires call_action to emit `action.stdout` events line-by-line, and (d) adds a new `_progress_panel` to src/watch.py alongside the existing log tail with 0.5s refresh. Derived from the approved plan at /Users/lenyk/.claude/plans/bright-kindling-kazoo.md. Consensus reached at ralplan iteration 2 after Critic caught an architecturally-impossible heartbeat synthesis.
scope_note: Must not regress the 310 existing tests + ruff clean. Flag-off prompt golden fixture (tests/fixtures/decider_prompt_flag_off.golden.txt) is a hard gate: a new test (RT-005) imports src.decider at module level and byte-compares the rendered flag-off prompt. One-way schema bump v2->v3 with WAL pragma idempotent. SQLite is the shared cross-process channel between daemon and watch; no new IPC, no new deps, stdlib only.

stories.title: Decider fire-and-forget emit queue + 11 state-transition sites
stories.evidence: src/decider.py: imports EventKind from .storage, adds _EMIT_QUEUE_SIZE=256 constant. DeciderProcessor.__init__ constructs self._emit_queue (asyncio.Queue maxsize=256), self._emit_drop_count=0, self._emit_drainer_task=None. Methods added: _safe_emit(kind, *, transcript_id, decision_id, payload) -> None (sync put_nowait; QueueFull -> increment drop counter + WARNING every 10th drop); _ensure_drainer() -> lazy loop.create_task start; _drain_events() -> long-lived loop awaiting queue.get() and calling store.log_event, catching all exceptions and continuing; shutdown() -> cancel drainer with 100ms grace. 12 emit call sites wired (decider.start L476-480, decider.done L490-497, decider.dropped_low_conf in low-conf branch, action.armed after setting pending_action, action.confirmed/cancelled/reprompt in _handle_confirmation three branches, action.executing after state=EXECUTING, action.call_start before call_action, action.done after log_action ok, action.error after log_action error, state.listening in _execute_pending finally AND _cancel_pending). tests/test_decider.py: +9 tests (queue overflow, drainer survives store failure, safe_emit under lock <50ms for 50 enqueues, drainer cleanup, emit sequence for act-yes/act-no/act-error/dropped_low_conf). Test count: 318 -> 327 (+9 including RT-005 canary), ruff clean, zero regressions.
stories.rationale: Surfaces every decider FSM transition as an event so the watch dashboard can show realtime progress instead of silence between transcript and decision. The fire-and-forget queue keeps emitters off the FSM critical path; put_nowait is sync so calling it inside `async with self._lock` adds zero blocking cost. 11 state-transition sites in decider.py + action.stdout emitted from claude_cli callback (covered by RT-003).
acceptanceCriteria: src/decider.py DeciderProcessor.__init__ adds: `self._emit_queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=256)`, `self._emit_drop_count = 0`, `self._emit_drainer_task: asyncio.Task | None = None`

src/decider.py adds method `def _safe_emit(self, kind: str, *, transcript_id=None, decision_id=None, payload=None) -> None` that calls `self._emit_queue.put_nowait(...)`, catches asyncio.QueueFull, increments _emit_drop_count, and logs a WARNING once per 10 drops

src/decider.py adds method `async def _drain_events(self) -> None` that loops `await self._emit_queue.get()` and calls `self.store.log_event(kind, transcript_id=..., decision_id=..., payload=...)`, wrapping the call in try/except that catches all exceptions and logs a WARNING — the drainer must never die

stories.title: ClaudeCLI._run streaming refactor + action.stdout emission
stories.evidence: src/claude_cli.py: _run adds on_line: Callable[[str], None] | None = None parameter; replaces proc.communicate() with `await asyncio.wait_for(self._read_streams(proc, on_line), timeout=self.timeout)`; new _read_streams method with concurrent drain_stdout/drain_stderr inner coroutines, asyncio.gather + proc.wait(), returns stripped (stdout, stderr) tuple; drain_stdout loop catches asyncio.LimitOverrunError and falls back to proc.stdout.read(8192), splits on BOTH \r and \n so progress-bar tools (pytest -v, pip, npm) render as visible motion, calls on_line per non-empty segment wrapped in try/except logging WARNING on exceptions. call_action adds `on_line` kwarg plumbed through to _run. call_decider unchanged (JSON output, no streaming). src/decider.py _execute_pending defines inner _stdout_emit closure that calls self._safe_emit(ACTION_STDOUT, decision_id, payload={'line': line[:8192]}) and passes it as on_line to call_action. tests/test_claude_cli.py: rewrote _make_mock_proc helper (renamed internals to _make_readline + _split_readline_items) to support BOTH legacy .communicate path AND new readline path via async-function direct assignment. Critical: switched from `side_effect=list` (exhausted on retry reuse) to cursor-closure that returns b'' forever after EOF. test_run_timeout_kills_process updated to use asyncio.Event().wait() for the hang (sleep-based hangs return instantly when asyncio.sleep is globally patched). +5 new RT-003 tests (streams_stdout_via_on_line, splits_on_cr_for_progress_bars, call_action_plumbs_on_line, stderr_drained_in_parallel, on_line_callback_exception_does_not_break_stream). tests/test_decider.py: +1 test (emits_action_stdout_per_line) verifies 3 stdout lines become 3 action.stdout events with correlated decision_id. Test count: 327 -> 333 (+6), ruff clean, zero regressions.
stories.rationale: This is the load-bearing piece that satisfies the literal user sentence 'see how they change during invocation'. Current _run uses proc.communicate() which blocks until subprocess exit — no incremental output. Refactor to async readline with concurrent stderr drain, optional on_line callback plumbed through call_action, \r-splitting for progress-bar tools, 8KB LimitOverrunError fallback. Test-mock blast radius is mechanical: one _make_fake_proc helper covers the 30+ existing fake_create_subprocess_exec sites.
acceptanceCriteria: src/claude_cli.py _run adds optional parameter `on_line: Callable[[str], None] | None = None`

stories.title: Flag-off decider-import canary test
stories.evidence: tests/test_decider.py::test_decider_import_does_not_break_flag_off_render added. Imports src.decider explicitly at test-module scope, constructs ContextBuilder with speaker_id_enabled=False, uses the same fixed-ctx dict as test_context.py::test_golden_string_flag_off_render (fixed time, mode, recent_transcripts, transcript, speaker_rule_block via _render_rule_block), renders prompts/decider.txt via builder.render, byte-compares to tests/fixtures/decider_prompt_flag_off.golden.txt. Also asserts 'Speaker: owner' not in the rendered output. Zero drift detected: the RT-002 decider changes (EventKind import, _emit_queue, _safe_emit helper, _drain_events method, shutdown, 12 emit sites) have NO import-time side effects that affect prompt rendering.
stories.rationale: Principle 4 enforcement. The existing test_golden_string_flag_off_render in tests/test_context.py renders through ContextBuilder but never imports src.decider. A new test imports src.decider at module level and byte-compares the rendered flag-off prompt to the existing golden fixture — this is the real canary.
